behaviour: The lab scheduler serves the git bundle of a graded commit without writing a file outside its store: git writes the bundle, prerequisite on the commit's parents, to standard output and the scheduler returns those bytes, so the bundle route answers a worker from a container with a read only root and no temp folder.
seam: scripts.ci_lab.scheduler.MirrorExpander.bundle over a real git repository holding a merge commit, and the /bundle route of scripts.ci_lab.lease_api over a real expander, each in a process with no usable temp folder
